description: Western Provincial Council - By Laws for the Parking of Vehicles within the Administrative limits of Colombo Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of new by-laws for vehicle parking regulations within the Colombo Municipal Council. It establishes legal frameworks, defines terms, sets prohibitions, and outlines enforcement procedures. The content focuses on regulatory matters and legal provisions rather than government personnel changes, organizational structures, or any of the other specialized categories. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "new laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations" and "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements."
